approvals.decision: ADR-002 — Defer the Bazel 7/8 + Bzlmod migration
approvals.blocking_rationale: ADR-002 records a deferral and authorizes no code change. ADR-001 (the Xcode 27 repair) is independently implementable and does not depend on it, so the pipeline continues. This approval governs whether and when the Bazel migration is scheduled.
